column1: # VA windows for engine-stage units (tools/gbprogress.py): <unit-name prefix> include|exclude <lo> <hi>
# A unit may only pair with exe functions inside its include ranges (if any) and outside its exclude ranges.
# Two Lua builds: Gamebryo's LNUM-patched 3rdParty/Lua (gb:Lua/, engine/units-gb.json) at 0x1421e2000-0x142260000
# (with egfLua), and stock Lua 5.1.4 compiled as C (gb:Lua2/, engine/units-lib-lua.json) right after Crypto++ at
# 0x1423915d0-0x1423ae7f0. Most functions are byte-identical but for relocations, so each pairs only with its own copy.
gb:Lua/
gb:Lua2/
# CEF 3.3396.1786 libcef_dll_wrapper (engine/units-lib-cef.json, lb3): statically linked at 0x142778550-0x1427b6c90,
# between the libcef.dll import thunks and the Gamebryo renderer tail.
gb:cef/
# expat 2.0.1 (engine/units-lib-expat.json, lb2): after the second Lua copy
gb:expat/
# IJG jpeg-6b and libpng 1.6.17 (engine/units-lib-jpeg.json, units-lib-png.json, lb2): inside the Scaleform block
gb:jpeg/
gb:png/
# Crypto++ 5.6.2 (engine/units-lib-cryptopp.json, lb1): between the import thunks and the second Lua copy
gb:CryptoPP/
# its cryptlib.cpp AAD_CHANNEL and DEFAULT_CHANNEL statics (/O2 di in the library .text$di run, atexit thunks in .text$yd:
# AAD 0x142cc8bb0, DEFAULT 0x142cc8c20 by each ??__E lea rcx; gap4, fe66)
gb:CryptoPP/
gb:CryptoPP/
# PCRE 8.21 (engine/units-lib-pcre.json, lb2): Scaleform pcre.lib between the import thunks and the Gamebryo tail
gb:pcre/
# Crypto++ TUs the exe has no own code of (every pair is an ICF look-alike other TUs already match): compiled only so the
# full-exe closure links their names (fipstest/rsa/zlib/ida/shark/square vtables), never paired (sfr36 2026-10-24)
gb:CryptoPP/adler32
gb:CryptoPP/channels
gb:CryptoPP/fips140
gb:CryptoPP/gf256
gb:CryptoPP/gf2_32
gb:CryptoPP/pkcspad
gb:CryptoPP/skipjack
# 14283f8a0 is ?_SDMInit@D3D11ShaderConstantMap (FixedString = "$Globals" on the global its _SDMShutdown 14283f8c0 nulls);
# EffectLoad's byte-identical ??__Eg_NullVS took it by search (Effects11 is not in the exe, fe66)
gb:Effects11/EffectLoad
# 14014d1dc is ??__E_Fac_tidy_reg@std (msvcprt locale0): its lea rcx registers 142cc9aa0 = ??__F_Fac_tidy_reg; it sits in the packed (unpadded) toolchain
# .text$di run after ??__EvtMissing 14014d1d0 (comsupp), not in any engine TU; D3D11ShaderCore's kCAT_INVALID took it by search, so no gb unit may pair it (fe66)
gb:
# SchedulerLua's cat ??__E's in the exe are only kCAT_INVALID 140130220 and kCAT_LocalMessage 140130230 (lea rcx registers 142cc6920);
# its obj's ??__FkCAT_SendToProducer/NetEvent/NetSystem have no exe ??__E, so the yd pass slid them onto other TUs' kCAT_INVALID dtors (fe66)
gb:egfLua/SchedulerLua
